fact: The IMF summary of an August 2023 mission says the DGCI's Kontaktu platform, launched in 2021, replaced a paper-based system, and that since March 2022 all large and medium taxpayers must file electronically, with a taxpayer register in use whose physical addresses are inaccurate.
title: Guinea Bissau: Further Improvements in Tax Compliance; High-Level Summary Technical Assistance Report No. 2024/015
